bed.name: Hospital Bed
bed.description: A standard hospital bed with adjustable frame, mattress, pillow and headboard. Used for patient rest and recovery. Built with efficient low-poly geometry optimized for web rendering.

monitor.name: Patient Monitor
monitor.description: A bedside patient monitor displaying vital signs including heart rate, blood pressure and oxygen levels. Features an emissive display screen and metallic stand.

iv_stand.name: IV Stand
iv_stand.description: An intravenous drip stand used to deliver fluids and medication to patients. Features a telescoping pole, hook arm, IV bag and wheeled tripod base.

chair.name: Visitor Chair
chair.description: A comfortable visitor chair placed beside the patient bed. Features a padded seat, backrest and armrests with a lightweight metal frame.

cabinet.name: Medical Cabinet
cabinet.description: A medical storage trolley with three drawers for storing supplies and equipment. Features a clean white finish, drawer handles and wheeled base for easy movement.
